HOW TO USE

A little setup. A little magic.

For a clean result, keep the camera and lighting unchanged after capturing the empty scene.

  1. 01 · START

    Keep the camera still

    Set your device down, tap Start camera, and allow camera access.

  2. 02 · BACKGROUND

    Step out of view

    Tap Capture background. Stay out through the countdown until “Cloak ready” appears.

  3. 03 · CLOAK

    Match your cloth

    Bring in a solid-colored cloth. Pick its color or use Tap to sample.

  4. 04 · PHOTO

    Capture the magic

    When your cloth disappears, tap Take photo. Download or share from the preview.

MAGIC CAMERA

A free, private camera experiment that turns a colored cloth into an invisibility cloak—entirely on your device.

GitHub · ranaumarbilal31 ↗

QUICK START

How to use Magic Camera

  1. Stabilize the device. Place it on a fixed surface and do not move it after calibration.
  2. Start the camera. Allow camera permission when your browser asks.
  3. Capture the empty scene. Tap Capture background, leave the frame for all three countdown seconds, and wait until “Cloak ready” appears.
  4. Choose the cloth shade. Select a preset, or tap “Tap to sample” and then tap a bright, evenly lit part of your cloth.
  5. Tune the result. Adjust Color range until all of the cloth disappears. Add a little Edge softness if its outline looks harsh.
  6. Step behind the cloth. Keep the cloth open and smooth. Tap the shutter when you want to save a photo.
Safe and private

The live view, captured background, and effect are processed only inside your browser. Nothing is uploaded or stored on a server. A photo leaves the app only when you choose Download or Share.
